title: Tooling: 3.18× faster production R420 xcheck.rref via integer elimination with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, production `research/e8-bit-r420/code/xcheck.py:rref` still used Fraction row reduction on every nonempty frame. The opt-in adapter `research/r420-rref-performance/` already proved Aman’s PR367 primitive-integer elimination with identical check/mutants receipts. This PR wires that equivalent RREF into the **production** checker and updates `research/e8-bit-r420/MANIFEST.sha256` to the new digest.

No certificate κ pins change. The historical Fraction-era `xcheck.py` digest in `research/r420-triple-bases-seed01/SOURCES.json` is demoted to **provenance** (and dropped from live `VERIFY.json` inputs) so research-packages CI does not fail working-source drift after the production rewrite. Other historical inventories that record the Fraction-era digest without a registered VERIFY matrix are left as provenance.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3, five alternating fresh-process pairs gave stage-median-sum speedup **≈3.18×** (check ≈2.94×, controls ≈3.21×). Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Check and mutants stdout digests match the baseline checker; all 672 frame RREF/nullspace comparisons agree.

Package: `research/r420-rref-production/`.
Tip: `99cb4fbf2b55a5e8265e066a1e4793d92f9b5077`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/r420-rref-production/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/r420-rref-production/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r420-rref-production
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r420-triple-bases-seed01 --check-only
python3.12 -B research/r420-triple-bases-seed01/check_records.py
python3.12 -I -B research/r420-rref-production/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_R420_RREF_PRODUCTION frames=672 matrices=677 corruption=subprocess_failure check_sha=e4637c1fe38b certs=0 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/r420-rref-production outcome=completed
PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS
PASS_R420_TRIPLE_BASES_PRECISION_BOUNDARY …
PASS_IDENTICAL_R420_RREF_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Temp-copy sign-flip foil rejects via subprocess failure. Package gates under `-O` still launch assertion-enabled children. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated checker change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different delivery): `research/r420-rref-performance/` (opt-in integer RREF; this is the production wiring), Aman PR367 / `research/frame-algebra-performance`, [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2257) (same production-promotion + provenance-demotion pattern). No competing open PR on production `xcheck.rref` at refresh.

Credit **eumemic** (PR543 checker/harness/word), **Aman** (PR367 integer rows), and the authors of `research/r420-rref-performance/`.
